newsitem.title: UK: Freight rates extend decline, BFI near 4-year low.
newsitem.headline: Freight rates extend decline, BFI near 4-year low.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) ended the week with a new decline, of nine points to 1063 or just three above the four-year low of 1060 hit on August 8.
Brokers expect that scarcity of grain cargoes through October is likely to continue to take a toll.
Grains fixtures reported on Friday included Quan Zhou Hai 54,000 tonnes heavy grains US Gulf/Japan at $19.25 with no combination for 19-25 September to Continental.

Dreyfus now turns out to have fixed Aleslevada for 54,000 tonnes heavy grains US Gulf/Taiwan at $18.60 for 16-20 September. Thursday reports had this vessel fixed to Continental for USGulf/Japan at $19.25 without combination. Dreyfus has also fixed Vancouver 55,000 tonnes heavy grains US Gulf/Hamburg at $8.90 lumpsum equivalent 15-20 September. Coal/ore fixings included Orfeas 100,000 tonnes coal Richards Bay/Rotterdam at $5.00 scale/25,000 for October by Cobelfret.

Biffex futures were again weaker with most active October down 20 at 1190 by 1530 GMT in volume of 403 lots. "There is further evidence of weaker fixtures. The new fall on the (BFI) index triggered selling", a broker said.
